source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and the human urinary system (PDF 12-13).

blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum gurdon (kidneys) ki kamaal ki banawat aur un ka kaam dekhenge. Hum woh zindagi bachane wali technologies bhi parhenge jo is aham nizam ke kamzor parne par istemal hoti hain.

Urinary ya excretory system excretion ka zimmedar hai. Biology mein excretion (ikhraj) woh amal hai jis ke zariye jandar metabolic fuzlaat (jism ke kimiyai amal se bane bekaar madde) bahar nikalta hai. Metabolic fuzlaat mein nitrogen wale fuzlaat (nitrogenous wastes), zaid pani aur zaid namak waghera shamil hain. Urinary system ek hi waqt mein teen zaroori kaam karta hai:

items: Nitrogen wale fuzle nikalna: urea ko khoon se chhaan kar nikalna; urea jigar (liver) mein protein ke tootne se banne wala nitrogen wala fuzla hai.
Osmoregulation: khoon mein "pani aur namak" ka tawazun rakhna; is ke liye gurde tay karte hain ke kitna pani wapas jism mein liya jaye (reabsorb) aur kitna bahar nikala jaye.
pH aur ions ka qaboo: sodium, potassium aur hydrogen ions ki miqdar ka tawazun rakhna, taa ke khoon thora sa basic (pH taqreeban 7.4) rahe.

blocks.title: Critical Thinking (sochne ki baat)
blocks.text: Excretion ki tareef ko saamne rakhte hue, bari aant (large intestine) ko bara excretory organ kyun nahin kaha jata? Jawab: excretion mein woh metabolic fuzlaat nikalte hain jo jism ke cells ke andar kimiyai amal se bante hain. Faeces (pakhana) zyada tar woh khurak hai jo hazam hi nahin hui aur kabhi jism ke cells mein dakhil nahin hui; is ka nikalna egestion kehlata hai, excretion nahin. (Yeh jawab aam biology hai, kitab mein chhapa nahin.)

Insani urinary system mein do gurde (kidneys), do ureters, ek urinary bladder (peshab ki thaili) aur ek urethra hoti hai. Gurde pait ki cavity (abdominal cavity) ke upar wale hisse mein, reerh ki haddi (vertebral column) ke dono taraf ek ek, 12wen thoracic aur 3re lumbar vertebrae ke darmiyan hote hain. Jigar ki jagah ki wajah se dayan (right) gurda bayen (left) gurde se thora neeche aur thora chhota hota hai. Dono gurdon ke upar wale hisson ko 11wen aur 12wen pasliyan (ribs) kuch had tak bachati hain. Ureters taqreeban 25 cm lambi nalyan hain. Har ureter gurde ke andar keep (funnel) jaise renal pelvis se shuru hoti hai. Dono gurdon ki ureters neeche ja kar ek hi urinary bladder mein khulti hain. Ureters peshab ko gurde se urinary bladder tak le jati hain. Urinary bladder ek khokhla aur phailne wala (distensible) muscular organ hai. Yeh pelvic cavity (koolhe ki haddiyon ke beech ki jagah) mein hota hai aur peshab jama karne ka kaam karta hai. Urethra woh nali hai jo peshab ko urinary bladder se jism ke bahar le jati hai.

blocks.alt: Dhar (trunk) ka saamne ka manzar aur peshab ka nizam: pait ke oopar do gurde, inferior vena cava (neeli) aur aorta (laal) ke qareeb; har gurde se ureter neeche pelvis mein peshab ki thaili (urinary bladder) tak, aur bladder ke neeche urethra. Tasveer mein baayan gurda poora hai aur dayan kaat kar dikhaya gaya hai taa ke renal pelvis nazar aaye.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Hilum, Kidney, Renal pelvis, Ureter, Urinary bladder, Urethra. Dekhne wale ke baayen wala gurda doosre se thora neeche hai.

blocks.prompt: Urinary system ke aaza us tarteeb se likhiye jis mein peshab un se guzarta hai.
blocks.explanation: Gurde (peshab banta aur renal pelvis mein jama hota hai), ureters, urinary bladder, urethra.

items: Excretion = metabolic fuzlaat (nitrogenous wastes, zaid pani, zaid namak) bahar nikalna.
Urinary system ke teen kaam: urea nikalna, osmoregulation, pH aur ions ka qaboo (khoon pH taqreeban 7.4).
Aza: 2 gurde (12wen thoracic se 3re lumbar vertebra tak; dayan gurda thora neeche aur chhota), 2 ureters (taqreeban 25 cm), ek urinary bladder, ek urethra.
